title: 第021章 揭人不揭短打人不打脸啊主任第022章 你以为他们不想么
lines: 超级学神系统：宿主苏恒。
灵木系进化方向。
修为：灵化二重。
功法：木神功（3品）
术法：木神术1级入门，育灵术1级普通、飞藤术1级入门、花神术1级入门。
灵植培育学0级精通。
灵植改良学0级普通。
灵植学等级1级精通。
土壤学等级0级精通。
辅灵学等级1级精通。
综合评价：理论知识1级45分，实践能力1级39分。
站在自己对应的阵法小高台内，面对身前受损严重频临死亡的灵星果树，苏恒果断催动木神功打出了最强的木神术。
这是灵木师最最最最重要的术法，每一次木神术运转都在向灵植输送着庞大的木之本源，本源生命力，精纯而庞大，能十倍几十倍强化一株灵植的免疫力体系。
除了免疫力系统，不管人类还是其他一切生命，其生长过程都是走向一个衰老过程，通俗的说从细胞到各式各样的器官，每时每刻都在变化，从最初的昌盛一步步走向死亡。
但木神术提供的生命本源，却让你一直维持最初的昌盛，就算你在时间流逝里，原本的细胞或各种器官，在变化分裂重组中损失了一部分，可那损失的，还没有木神术补充的多。
这就相当于你最纯粹的生命力本源，不止不会随着时间流逝而损耗，反而一直在增强。
林林总总各式各样的因素铺垫下，木神术一出，苏恒面前垂死的灵星果树，一下子就变的灵动起来，还多了几分生机。
只有木神术，还是不够的。
木神术的发挥，需要时间。
苏恒果断催动1级入门的育灵术，这是灵木师仅次于木神术的重要术法，它可以加速催生灵植的生长过程，比如正常的灵星果树在合适环境下，需要十年从幼苗成长到成熟，但育灵术不断砸下去，能一次次极具缩短过程。
强大的灵木师催动八九级育灵术，能把十年生长周期，缩短为几天！这过程少不了木神术的配合，没有木神术配合的话，你过度催化他的生长效率，只会让各式各样的如光照、温度、水分、微量元素等营养跟不上，育灵术只加速生长或者细胞不断分裂走向死亡的效率，无法做到提供养分的。
上午的一次理论战，苏恒取得第一名后，又被奖励了1级育灵术，这时候两者配合，就是完美！
都是1级程度的术法，一轮砸下去，几十个呼吸的酝酿过程，重伤垂危的灵星果树就气色好转了不少。
苏恒的损耗也不小，最高级别的术法砸出去，对他修为损耗也大，以他的估计，这样的修为损耗，他只要再砸出去两三轮，就会修为耗空。
“修为，我的修为太弱了，只是灵化2重巅峰，而1级的木神术、育灵术，都是指全国大四毕业生里，优秀水准的，越强力强效的术法，对修为的需求也就越大。若我现在是灵化三重巅峰，或者四重，能一口气把这一株灵星果树治愈，可现在是做不到了。”
content_en:
Super God of Learning System: Host Su Heng.
The evolution direction of the spiritual wood system.
Cultivation: Second level of spiritualization.
Kung Fu: Wood God Kung Fu (Level 3)
Techniques: Wood Divine Technique level 1 entry level, Spirit Nurturing Technique level 1 ordinary, Flying Vine Technique level 1 entry level, Flower Divine Technique level 1 entry level.
Level 0 proficiency in spiritual plant cultivation.
Level 0 of Spiritual Plant Improvement is ordinary.
Proficient at level 1 of spiritual plant science.
Proficient in soil science level 0.
Auxiliary spirituality level 1 proficiency.
…
Comprehensive evaluation: Theoretical knowledge level 1 is 45 points, and the practical ability level 1 is 39 points.
Standing on the small platform corresponding to his own formation, facing the severely damaged Lingxing Fruit Tree in front of him, which was on the verge of death, Su Heng decisively activated the Wood God Technique and unleashed the strongest Wood God Technique.
This is the most important technique of the spiritual wood master. Every operation of the wood magic is delivering the huge source of wood to the spiritual plant. The original vitality is pure and huge, and can strengthen the immune system of a spiritual plant ten or dozens of times.
In addition to the immune system, the growth process of human beings and all other forms of life is towards an aging process. In layman's terms, from cells to various organs, they are changing every moment, from initial prosperity to death step by step.
But the source of life provided by the Wood God Technique allows you to maintain your original prosperity. Even if your original cells or various organs lose part of your original cells or various organs during the changes, divisions and reorganizations over time, the loss is not as much as the Wood God Technique can replenish it.
This is equivalent to the purest source of your vitality. Not only will it not be lost with the passage of time, but it will always be enhanced.
…
Under the foreshadowing of all kinds of factors, as soon as the wood magic was used, the dying spirit star fruit tree in front of Su Heng suddenly became more alive and more alive.
Wood magic alone is not enough.
It takes time to develop the wood magic.
Su Heng decisively activated the Level 1 entry-level Spiritual Nurturing Technique, which is an important technique for spiritual wood masters after the Wood God Technique. It can accelerate the growth process of spiritual plants. For example, a normal spirit star fruit tree takes ten years to grow from a seedling to maturity under the right environment, but the Spiritual Nurturing Technique can shorten the process time and time again if the Spiritual Nurturing Technique is continued.
The powerful spiritual wood master activates the eighth- and ninth-level spiritual cultivation techniques, which can shorten the ten-year growth cycle to just a few days! This process requires the cooperation of the Wood God Technique. Without the cooperation of the Wood God Technique, if you over-catalyze its growth efficiency, it will only make it unable to keep up with various nutrients such as light, temperature, moisture, trace elements, etc. The Spirit Nurturing Technique only accelerates growth or the cells continue to divide and die, but cannot provide nutrients.
In a theoretical battle in the morning, after Su Heng won first place, he was awarded Level 1 Spiritual Nurturing Technique. At this time, the combination of the two was perfect!
They were all level 1 spells. After one round of smashing, and within dozens of breaths of preparation, the seriously injured and dying Lingxing Fruit Tree's complexion improved a lot.
Su Heng's losses were not small. Spelling out the highest-level spells would also cause a great loss to his cultivation. According to his estimate, with such a loss of cultivation, he would be completely exhausted as long as he throws out it for two or three more rounds.
"Cultivation, my cultivation is too weak. I am only at the peak of the second level of spiritualization. The level 1 Wood Divine Technique and the Spiritual Nurturing Technique refer to the outstanding level among senior graduates in the country. The more powerful and powerful the spells are, the greater the demand for cultivation. If I were at the third level of spirituality, or the fourth level, I could heal this spiritual star fruit tree in one breath, but I can't do it now."
